name: keycast-studio
description: Screen recorder that shows every key you press, polishes clicks with auto-zoom and turns your voice into subtitles.
author: dominkang90

scripts.package: electron-packager . "KeyCast Studio" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --ignore=^/src --ignore=^/release --ignore=^/tests --ignore=^/web/ --ignore=^/vite\..*config\.js$ --ignore=\.cmd$ --ignore=\.lnk$ --ignore=^/docs --ignore=\.md$ --ignore=^/scripts --ignore=^/\.github --ignore=electron-builder\.yml --ignore=^/dist/assets/.*\.wasm$ --icon=build/icon.ico --app-copyright="Copyright (c) 2026 dominkang90" --win32metadata.CompanyName=dominkang90 --win32metadata.FileDescription="KeyCast Studio" --win32metadata.ProductName="KeyCast Studio" && node scripts/after-package.cjs && node tests/check-package.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:web && npm run package
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run bundle:ffmpeg && npm run bundle:wgc && electron-builder --win --prepackaged "release/KeyCast Studio-win32-x64"
scripts.start:packaged: npm run build:ui && npm run package && node scripts/run-packaged.cjs
